answers.core: This is about making it easier to create good-looking VFX with the built-in tools provided by Godot.
answers.workaround: This can be worked around using a MeshInstance3D + QuadMesh setup with a custom material. However, this requires a fair bit more work, especially if you want to simulate AnimatedSprite3D's behavior.

title: Reimplement support for overbright modulate values in Sprite3D
